entities.name: Napoleon Bonaparte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: French military leader and Emperor (1769–1821) who rose to power during the French Revolution and conquered much of Europe. His Napoleonic Code reformed legal systems across the continent, and his wars reshaped the European order.
